## A test of citation reading

Ada Lovelace 1 , Alan Turing 2

## Introduction

Rare disease diagnosis still fails for most patients 1 . Population databases shape how variants are read 2 . Genome sequencing in a national health system raised the yield 3 . Deep learning has changed many fields 4 . Protein structure can now be predicted 5 . Short reads are aligned with fast index methods 6 . Gapped alignment scales to large genomes 7 . Count data need their own statistical models 8 . Visual inspection of alignments remains useful 9 . We grew 10 5 cells on 3 m 2 plates (n = 12), as in Fig. 2. Reads on chr11 and exon2 were counted at day3. This agrees with earlier work 2 . (1) prepare the samples. (2) sequence them.
